description:
Love-chan, a streamer, is worried about the lack of views on her gameplay videos, so her friend suggests she try streaming using her own body. The views skyrocket, and Love-chan, wanting to satisfy her desire for self-expression, even goes so far as to hold an offline meet-up at a karaoke bar, something her friend told her never to do. Love-chan is drugged by a bad guy at the karaoke bar and passes out. The other fans who have gathered can only watch in silence as Love-chan is "taken home". Love-chan is made to sleep in a hotel room in her underwear by a bad guy...

(Source: PinkPineapple, translated and edited)
